description:
Give the worktree identity file and the server's pid and log files `VirtualPath` constants, and use them at each site.

## Background

`worktree.json` is spelled at `crates/jit/src/storage/worktree_identity.rs:107,123,218`, `server.pid.json` and `server.log` at `commands/serve.rs:70,557`, and `crates/server/src/watcher.rs:89` matches `events.jsonl`, `claims.jsonl`, `server.pid.json` and `server.log` by name. These files live under `.jit`. Claims, leases and locks under `.git/jit/` are control-plane files, not `.jit` files.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `VirtualPath` declares constants for the worktree identity file, the server pid file and the server log.
- [hard] REQ-02: No string literal in `storage/worktree_identity.rs`, `commands/serve.rs` or the server watcher names one of these files or the event log; `.git/jit/` file names stay as they are.
title: Worktree and server files under .jit have VirtualPath constants
